ur.title: Usne sirf ek kutte ko paani pilaya… phir jo hua, yakeen nahi hoga 😳
alts: Ek joota, ek kuan, ek pyasa kutta… aur ek bada faisla
Ye chhoti si neki kitni badi thi? Aakhir tak dekhna
ur.description:
Tapta registan. Pyaas se behaal ek musafir. Aur kuen ke paas ek kutta jo zameen chaat raha tha…
Us pal usne jo kiya, uska anjaam aapko hairaan kar dega.

💬 Aap uski jagah hote to kya karte? Comment mein batayein.

📖 Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 2363

en.title: He only gave a thirsty dog some water… what happened next is unbelievable 😳
alts: One well, one shoe, one thirsty dog… and one huge reward
How big can a tiny good deed be? Watch till the end
en.description:
A burning desert. A traveller dying of thirst. And by the well, a dog licking the wet sand…
What he did in that moment, and what it led to, will surprise you.

💬 What would you have done in his place? Tell us in the comments.

📖 Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 2363
🔔 A new Islamic story every week: subscribe.

scenes.narration: Ek baar ek musafir pyaas se behaal tha. Use ek kuan mila.
scenes.voiceText: एक बार एक मुसाफ़िर प्यास से बेहाल था। उसे एक कुआँ मिला।

en.text: Once, a traveller was suffering from terrible thirst. Then he found a well.

scenes.narration: Woh neeche utra aur paani peekar bahar aaya.
scenes.voiceText: वह नीचे उतरा, और पानी पीकर बाहर आया।

en.text: He climbed down, drank the water and came back up.

scenes.narration: Wahan ek kutta pyaas se tadapkar geeli mitti chaat raha tha.
scenes.voiceText: वहाँ एक कुत्ता प्यास से तड़पकर, गीली मिट्टी चाट रहा था।

en.text: There he saw a dog, panting with thirst and licking the wet mud.

scenes.narration: Usne dobara kuen mein utarkar apne joote mein paani bhara.
scenes.voiceText: उसने दोबारा कुएँ में उतरकर, अपने जूते में पानी भरा।

en.text: He went down the well again and filled his leather sock with water.

scenes.narration: Aur us bejubaan kutte ko paani pilaya.
scenes.voiceText: और उस बेज़ुबान कुत्ते को पानी पिलाया।

en.text: And he gave that voiceless dog water to drink.

scenes.narration: Allah ko uski ye neki itni pasand aayi ki uske gunah maaf farma diye.
scenes.voiceText: अल्लाह को उसकी यह नेकी इतनी पसंद आई, कि उसके गुनाह माफ़ फ़रमा दिए।

en.text: Allah loved this good deed so much that He forgave his sins.
